reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, though the daily-schedule weekend skip is written again rather than shared with getNextDate.

duplication.why: The RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb skeleton mirrors getUpcomingDates and the 'daily skips, others move' weekend rule repeats the one embedded in shared getNextDate.

placement.why: A new handler next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts is where the tree exposes schedule date queries, though the per-occurrence weekend decision would better sit in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the handler plus tests; adds a redundant namespace import of #shared/months alongside the existing named import.

maintainability.why: Readable, but the weekend rule now lives in three forms (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) that can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and RSchedule; no existing per-occurrence adjust helper is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange map in schedules/app.ts re-expresses getNextDate's daily-weekend skip as a null-return plus filter instead of a shared occurrence-adjust function.
